units.title: Blast freezer
units.text: A blast freezer rapidly removes heat from packaged food by circulating very cold air at high velocity so the product reaches its target core temperature quickly.

units.title: Opening the evaporator room
units.text: Before the evaporator-room door is opened after an ammonia alarm, the area monitor must show a safe reading and the shift supervisor must confirm that the ventilation purge is complete.

units.title: Defrost scheduling
units.text: The refrigeration operator schedules evaporator defrost cycles and records each completed cycle in the plant log.

units.title: Door moisture control
units.text: Dock doors are kept closed between vehicle movements because warm humid air can create frost on floors and evaporator surfaces.

units.title: Checking a product probe
units.text: The technician places the probe in the reference bath, waits for the reading to stabilize and records any calibration offset.
